# Fictional presentation compositions

These equal-status test compositions are not customer templates or package defaults.
All people, work and contacts are fictional. External links use example.com and
the telephone is a reserved fictional North American number.

`sculpture.webp` is a 320px delivery encoding of an original image created with
the built-in imagegen tool on 2026-10-12. Prompt: “Create one square original
editorial illustration for a fictional personal profile card test fixture: a
small handmade ceramic sculpture with an unusual arch and sphere, sitting on a
studio shelf, painterly tactile paper texture, simple centered composition that
remains clear at 160 pixels. No real person, branding, logos, letters, words,
numbers, watermark, or recognizable commercial product. This is fictional sample
art for a reusable website library, not a brand identity. Warm neutral studio
lighting, restrained earth colors.”

The source image was visually inspected. No client assets or private references
are included. Image/no-image and optional-contact cases use the same compositions.
